findings.title: NPE risk if webauthnAuth is null but passkeys considered enabled
findings.body: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()) checks webauthnAuth != null before calling webauthnAuth.fillContextForm, but UsernamePasswordForm() (no-arg constructor) sets webauthnAuth=null; since isConditionalPasskeysEnabled already guards with webauthnAuth != null this specific path is safe, but subclasses overriding isConditionalPasskeysEnabled (e.g. in UsernameForm) without updating guard could reintroduce NPE. No test exercises the no-webauthn constructor path with context.getUser() non-null + override, so this is a fragile invariant depending on method ordering across subclasses.

findings.title: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() called without user param causing inconsistent behavior
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() (no-arg), but UsernamePasswordForm only defines isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user); presumably an overload exists but is not shown in the diff for this file. If no no-arg overload exists in UsernamePasswordForm, this is a compile error; if it does exist elsewhere, its semantics (independent of user) differ from the user-aware check used elsewhere in the same class, risking inconsistent skip-decisions between UsernameForm.authenticate and UsernamePasswordForm.authenticate for the same user context.

findings.title: Behavior change to shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators affects subclasses silently
findings.body: WebAuthnAuthenticator.fillContextForm now delegates to shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators(context) instead of a direct null check on user, and WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator overrides it to always return false. This means WebAuthnPasswordlessAuthenticator (parent of WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator) will never show allowed authenticators even in 2FA-style flows where it inherits this authenticator type without the conditional override; verify this is intentional and tested for all subclasses, not only the conditional-UI case covered by new tests.

findings.title: Widened visibility of internal auth note constant
findings.body: USER_SET_BEFORE_USERNAME_PASSWORD_AUTH was changed from protected to public solely to be referenced from AuthenticatorUtils via static import. This increases the public API surface of an internal implementation detail; consider exposing it through a method rather than a public constant to avoid external code depending on this auth note key.
